verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a public government service could serve readable guidance pages. But the probe shows the e-FRRO root returns HTTP 200 with only a script-style application shell that converts to 12 characters of text for a keyless agent, and the long-published entry path returns 404. The public reading surface is therefore not usable by a standard agent. The probe's own note that script tags were absent slightly muddies the JS-shell diagnosis, but either way no readable guidance content was served.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
